name: Reasonix
description: Single-binary Go coding agent with terminal, desktop and browser front ends, plan mode, permissions, sandboxing and checkpoints.
whatItDoes: Reasonix edits and runs code under the user's supervision, with the option to roll back to earlier checkpoints. It started around DeepSeek models and can be used from a terminal, a desktop app or a browser. Editors can also embed it as an agent.
howItWorks: One Go binary contains the agent loop, a permission system and a sandbox for commands. Settings live in a TOML file created by a setup command, and tool servers are added as plugins. It can run interactively or execute a single task from the command line.
run: reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go"
